FORNITORI TOTALE PERIODO (line 2537) sums vociExtraPeriod (DAILY+WEEKLY+MONTHLY) + fatturePeriodoStats.totale + fatturePeriodoStats.totaleContanti — correct double-coverage of cash quota now displayed as 'Include €X di fatture + €Y in contanti' (line 2540-2549). Verified.
fornitoriTotals (lines 1131-1185) classifies fattureLog into fatturata/libera so the Pie 'Fatturata vs Contanti' shows €380/€220. Verified.
totNetto (line 1363-1397) subtracts both fatturePeriodoStats.totale and .totaleContanti under !excludeFornitori — prevents netto drift. Verified: NETTO shows €-600 with lordo=0.
weatherStats state confirmed removed (round 76) — file has only a removal comment at line 297, no setter/getter present.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Bug fix Round 77 verified via Playwright with mobile viewport 390x844. Public URL https://marketmate-hub-1.preview.emergentagent.com/. Default filter is 'Sett.' (week of today). Verified results across Sett./Mese/Anno filters: (1) FATTURE TOT=€380 with count=2, (2) FORNITORI TOT=€600, (3) Pie Fatturata €380 / Contanti €220 (63%/37%), (4) 'TOTALE FORNITORI PERIODO €600 — Include €380 di fatture + €220 in contanti', (5) Ripartizione per fornitore: Forn C €300, Forn A €200, Forn B €100. NETTO = €-600 (correct, lordo=0 minus 600 forn). The 'TOTALE FORNITORI PERIODO' and 'Include …' text are inside the FORNITORI expandable section (collapsed['fornLines']=true by default), so the section must be tapped to expand before they become visible — that is by design. No regressions seen. Round 76 weatherStats removal also confirmed (no residual reference in stats.tsx).
rca_of_issue: Original bug: fattureLog entries with modoPagamento='contanti' were being summed into the FATTURE total (totale) and ALSO appearing in the FORNITORI 'libera/contanti' bucket, producing double-count. Round 77 fix splits fatturePeriodoStats into `totale` (only modoPagamento==='fattura' + importoFattura of 'misto') and `totaleContanti` (only modoPagamento==='contanti' + importoContanti of 'misto'). The FATTURE riquadro now shows only `totale`, while TOTALE FORNITORI PERIODO sums both quotas + voci extra; netto subtracts both. Period filtering uses dataEmissione against the same boundaries as filteredByTime (isSameDay/Week/Month/Year vs dataRiferimento). Verified end-to-end.
